_note: Container images for GEAK CI e2e runs (repo-tracked). This is the DEFAULT preset; sibling presets live in ci/docker_setup/*.json and are selected per-run by the Actions variable vars.DOCKER_DEFAULT_JSON (a bare filename in this folder; unset -> docker_default.json). The CI resolves it to DOCKER_DEFAULT=ci/docker_setup/<name>, which lib.sh honors. resolve_image(framework, model_key) in ci/lib.sh picks in this precedence: (1) IMAGE=<repo:tag> env override; (2) models[<model_key>] — a per-model pin, either a plain string or an {arch: image} dict; (3) [framework][arch]; (4) [framework].default; (5) first image listed for the framework. arch is MI355 (gfx950/MI35x) or MI300 (gfx942/gfx90a/MI30x), auto-detected on the compute node (override with GEAK_GPU_ARCH). Defaults now come from the internal harbor.crusoe registry. NOTE: the sglang harbor image is an MI35x build, so MI300 stays on the previous primussafe mi30x 'profilerfix' image (ROCm 7.2.0) until an MI30x build of v0.5.17 is published; swap it here when one exists. 'models' is intentionally EMPTY — every enrolled model resolves via its framework default (framework comes from each model's handoff.json). Add a per-model pin here only to deviate from the default.
